in_hebrew.name: Fonz
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Nickname derived from 'Arthur Fonzarelli'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fonz הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from an Italian surname, Fonz means 'son of Fortunato'. The name is popularly known from the sitcom 'Happy Days' where Arthur Fonzarelli, played by Henry Winkler, was a lovable character with a strong personality. He was the friend everyone wanted, the one who would be there to help and make things right.
